notes.title: WHAT IS THIS!??
notes.content:
Hello! I am Nekod, the sole developer of Meowphoria. The idea of ​​the project is quite non-trivial, so I should tell you what this game will be about.
This is a mixture of genres such as metroidvania, dating simulator, and squad manager (probably real-time strategy)

The gameplay will rest on three pillars:
[list]
[*] Exploration of the world, battles with bosses, various mobs
[*] Creating (or not creating, as you choose) relationships with the cat girls you like, delving into the story written for each of them
[*] Experiments with harem builds, because the entire subsequent gameplay and how effectively you will smear all sorts of enemies will depend on which cat girls you take into your team
[/list]
At first glance, it may seem to you that the game is in complete chaos, but rest assured... You are right! The emphasis in Meowphoria is on fun, experimentation and at the same time a deeply thought-out, interactive story based on unusual characters

Thank you for adding the game to your wishlist! This gives me incentive to move forward!
